rows.note: This is the all-purpose legal verb for formally bringing a criminal or civil court action.

example.english: The lawyer decided to prosecute the company involved and seek compensation for the losses.
example.traditional: 律師決定起訴涉案公司，要求賠償損失。
example.jyutping: leot6 si1 kyut3 ding6 hei2 sou3 sip3 on3 gung1 si1 jiu1 kau4 pui4 soeng4 syun2 sat1

rows.note: Use this specifically when the authorities prosecute someone for a criminal offence.

example.english: The police will prosecute the driver suspected of drunk driving.
example.traditional: 警方落案檢控涉嫌醉駕嘅司機。
example.jyutping: ging2 fong1 lok6 on3 gim2 hung3 sip3 jim4 zeoi3 gaa3 ge3 si1 gei1

rows.note: Use this when filing a claim or legal action in court to pursue a right or obtain something through legal process.

example.english: The landlord decided to prosecute a claim in court to recover the unpaid rent.
example.traditional: 業主為咗追討欠租，決定入稟法院。
example.jyutping: jip6 zyu2 wai6 zo2 zeoi1 tou2 him3 zou1 kyut3 ding6 jap6 ban2 faat3 jyun2
